tickets.title: Prerequisite Validation
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the system to automatically validate course prerequisites, so that I do not accidentally select courses I am not eligible to take.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system checks prerequisite requirements when a student adds a course.
- A warning message is displayed if prerequisites are not satisfied.
- Students can view which prerequisite is missing.
- Courses with unmet prerequisites cannot be added to the roadmap unless an advisor override exists.
- PASS: The system correctly
